title: Historical SFY 2017 transit grant application and compliance compilation workflow
summary: The FY2017 Section 5310, 5311 and 5339 application binders show a recurring grant-compilation workflow: define service/project need, assemble operating/capital and coordination evidence, attach organizational/legal/fiscal documentation, satisfy program-specific civil-rights/ADA/EEO/DBE/procurement/safety/lobbying/charter/school-bus assurances, document local match and budgets, and submit an indexed signed package for state/federal review.

claims.claim: The three FY2017 grant applications use checklist-driven binder assembly with signed certifications and multiple recurring compliance attachments.
Civil-rights and accessibility compliance artifacts are not isolated HR documents; they functioned as required evidence in RTEC's transit-grant application process.

evidence.note: Includes Title VI, 504, local civil-rights and disabled/equivalent-service assurances.
Includes Title VI, annual civil-rights assurance, AAP, LEP, 504, disabled assurance, ADA equivalent service.
Includes local civil-rights, disabled assurance and equivalent-service certification.

claims.claim: Procurement, local match, budgeting and equipment specifications were formal grant-approval controls rather than informal administrative steps.

evidence.page_or_section: Part I project budgets and purchase requirements

trigger: Preparation of an annual/state-fiscal-year transit grant application or capital/operating funding request.
prerequisites: Current compliance documents required by the funding program
actors: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet / Office of Transportation Delivery
steps: Identify the funding program and requested project/service.
Compile current service/project description, justification and supporting operating/capital data.
Compile coordination, public/private-sector participation and planning evidence required by the program.
Compile financial capability, operating-fund/local-match, budget and detailed backup.
Compile vehicle/facility/equipment inventory, maintenance, specifications and procurement documentation.
Attach current program-required compliance plans, assurances and certifications.
Obtain required signatures/resolutions and verify each checklist item as complete or N/A.
Submit binder/application to KYTC/OTD and retain completeness/approval correspondence.
decisions: Which grant program and project category applies.
Whether each checklist item is applicable or N/A.
Whether local match and fiscal/managerial capability are sufficient.
Whether current compliance evidence satisfies each grant requirement.
Whether requested vehicles/equipment are replacement, expansion, new service or accessibility improvements.
controls: Checklist completion/NA requirement before state/federal approval.
Currentness/version checks for civil-rights, AAP, Title VI/LEP, ADA, DBE and other compliance attachments.
Competitive-procurement and independent cost estimate/specification evidence for applicable purchases.
